summary: CLI install: oc new-project ansible-automation-platform, apply a sub.yaml with an OperatorGroup and a Subscription (channel stable-2.6, source redhat-operators), wait for oc get csv to show Succeeded, then create an AnsibleAutomationPlatform CR enabling controller, eda and hub (file storage on a RWX class).
questions: How do I subscribe to the AAP Operator with oc?
AAP Operator Subscription and OperatorGroup YAML
How do I check the AAP Operator CSV phase?
Create an AnsibleAutomationPlatform CR from the CLI

answer_card.title: Install the AAP Operator with oc
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
oc new-project ansible-automation-platform
```
`sub.yaml`:
```yaml
apiVersion: operators.coreos.com/v1
kind: OperatorGroup
metadata:
  name: ansible-automation-platform-operator
  namespace: ansible-automation-platform
spec:
  targetNamespaces: [ansible-automation-platform]
---
apiVersion: operators.coreos.com/v1alpha1
kind: Subscription
metadata:
  name: ansible-automation-platform
  namespace: ansible-automation-platform
spec:
  channel: 'stable-2.6'
  installPlanApproval: Automatic
  name: ansible-automation-platform-operator
  source: redhat-operators
  sourceNamespace: openshift-marketplace
```
```bash
oc apply -f sub.yaml
oc get csv -n ansible-automation-platform   # PHASE Succeeded
```
Then create the `AnsibleAutomationPlatform` CR.
